A component answers from outside only where its app.yaml gives it a route. The others carry the app from within, and their address is how a component of this app reaches them.

Deploy

Point it at another tag to move the app there — a commit tag such as sha-905acce is how you go back to a version that worked, and the branch tag is how you come forward again.

Fetches the same tag once more, for when it was moved or something failed.

The connections themselves are defined on the connections page. A new domain or a Cloudflare connection in another account moves the app's record, and its tunnel with it; the app is deployed again from the artifact above. Without a Cloudflare connection, a quick tunnel can give the app a random address that changes whenever it restarts.
